name_input: OSHO TOOLS PVT. LTD.,; OSHO TOOLS PVT.LTD
export_evidence: No shipment row was ever displayed. importkey.com/countries/india/osho-tools-pvt-ltd and the variant .../osho-tools-pvt-ltd-1 both returned only the identical paywalled template text: "Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records of companies all over the world." — i.e. zero rows seen, and the same boilerplate appears for any slug, so it is not evidence of a record. volza.com/p/osho-tools/, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; no bill-of-lading number, date, destination or HS code could be read anywhere.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record was retrieved. Bing search for "OSHO TOOLS" PVT LTD export shipment india returned 137,000 nominal results but every top hit concerned the mystic Osho (wikipedia.org, osho.com, oshoworld.com) — no company page at all. The web_search tool failed on both attempts (searx: connection refused) and Google returned only a redirect interstitial, so no domestic source could be opened.
note: Nothing could be verified either way: this is an evidence-access failure, not a finding of absence. Source counter: 2 ImportKey slug variants fetched, 0 shipment rows rendered in either; 3 second-source trade platforms (volza, eximpedia, trademo) blocked with 403; 1 search engine (Bing) returned 0 relevant company hits out of 10 displayed results. Declared HS 820600 (interchangeable spanner/wrench sets) and industry "Авиастроение и транспорт" are unverified claims — no customs record was seen to confirm or correct the code, so no HS correction is proposed. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in any source reached). Per Rule 5, the absence of readable records is recorded as unknown, NOT as "declared, not confirmed" and NOT as "no supply traces found", because the paywalls prevented a genuine search rather than producing a negative result. Recommend re-running with a paid Volza/Eximpedia seat or a working search backend before any verdict; no rejection basis exists (no evidence of non-existence, liquidation or bankruptcy).
